items.title: 10.17.2 E standard qeematon se reaction ki feasibility (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 10.17.2 with Figures 10.9 and 10.10, printed pages 231-233.

blocks.text: Standard electrode potential qeematein batati hain ke kisi species ko oxidise ya reduce karna kitna aasan ya mushkil hai. Qeematein barhti manfi tarteeb mein likhi jati hain, har half-equation mein zyada oxidised shakal baen aur zyada reduced shakal daen. E standard jitna zyada musbat, half-equation ke aage chalne ka rujhan utna zyada aur baen taraf ki species utni aasani se reduce hoti hai; E standard jitna kam musbat, ulta chalne ka rujhan utna zyada aur daen taraf ki species utni aasani se oxidise hoti hai.

Mg2+ aur Ag ke darmiyan reaction ki feasibility jaanchne ke liye half-equations chahiye: Mg2+ + 2e- se Mg, E standard = -2.32 V (print; 10.17.3 mein -2.38 V aur Table 10.2 mein -2.37 V), aur Ag+ + e- se Ag, +0.80 V. Agar Mg2+ reduce aur Ag oxidise ho to E cell = E(reduction) - E(oxidation) = (-2.32) - (+0.80) = -1.52 V; manfi qeemat dikhati hai ke reaction mumkin nahi. Ag+ aur Mg ke darmiyan reaction mumkin hai, kyunke E cell = (+0.80) - (-2.32) = +1.52 V musbat hai (print pehli term -0.80 likhti hai).

Cu2+/Cu aur Zn2+/Zn jore ke liye zinc electrons khone ka zyada rujhan rakhta hai, to us half-cell mein reaction ulti chalti hai, Zn se Zn2+ + 2e-, aur dono half-equations mil kar Zn(s) + Cu2+(aq) se Zn2+(aq) + Cu(s) dete hain, cell mein hone wala reaction: zinc metal copper ions ke saath mumkin hai, aur agar aage ka reaction mumkin hai to ulta (copper metal zinc ions ke saath) mumkin nahi. 1.00 mol dm-3 Zn2+ solution mein rakha copper ka tukra react nahi karta. Half-equations ek doosre ke oopar likhne par reaction ki simt oopar baen se shuru ghari-war (clockwise) tarteeb (reactant, product, reactant, product) se milti hai (Figure 10.10): reaction us simt hota hai ke zyada taqatwar oxidising agent zyada taqatwar reducing agent se react kare.

blocks.prompt: Cell voltage se reaction ki feasibility kaise andaza lagai jati hai (exercise Q.2d), aur kya copper magnesium sulfate solution se react karega (Q.2g)?
blocks.explanation: Tajweez shuda reduction aur oxidation half-equations likhein, aur E cell = E(reduction) - E(oxidation) nikalein; musbat E cell ka matlab reaction mumkin hai, manfi ka matlab nahi. Copper Mg2+ ke saath: E cell = (-2.37) - (+0.34) manfi hai, to copper magnesium ko be-dakhal nahi karta aur koi reaction nahi hota.

items: Zyada musbat E standard: baen species aasani se reduce; zyada manfi: daen species aasani se oxidise. E cell = E(red) - E(ox) musbat ka matlab mumkin: Ag+ + Mg haan (+1.52 V), Mg2+ + Ag nahi (-1.52 V); Zn + Cu2+ haan, Cu + Zn2+ nahi.
Ghari-war usool (Figure 10.10): zyada taqatwar oxidising agent zyada taqatwar reducing agent se react karta hai.
